category_scope: Beauty & Personal Care (hair care, skin care, oral care); general rules where noted
how_brands_deliver_content: Self-service Jumia Vendor Center (one system for all Jumia countries): single "Add a Product" form, category Excel template import/export, or the Vendor Center API (product create/update feeds). Every creation or edit is validated automatically and then passes Jumia content Quality Check (QC) before it is published. Field-level limits (name, description, highlights) are defined per category attribute set inside Vendor Center / the API and are not published on the public VendorHub pages. Regulated categories (food, cosmetics, etc.) are limited to local sellers and Jumia-managed accounts according to the local policy pages; cross-border sellers use Jumia Global (vendor.jumia.com) with its own guidelines. Brand owners and authorised distributors/resellers can apply for Official Store status.

languages.note: Jumia Global beauty guideline: Senegal and Cote d'Ivoire must list products in French, "other countries must use English"; the Vendor API takes name and description "in default English language" with optional translations.
Same statement as for Nigeria. No local-language (e.g. Swahili) requirement is published.

rules.requirement: Product name is given in English and should consist of the actual product name plus, if available, colour, edition and speciality.
rules.source_title: VC - Global Product Management (GPM) & Global Order Processing (GOP) API (OpenAPI definition, version "latest")
rules.notes: Wording of the "name" field in the Vendor API product-creation schema ("For a better listing quality, the name should consist the actual product name, if available colour, edition, speciality").

rules.requirement: Product-name length limits are not published on VendorHub; attribute validation (min/max length, character type, list values) is defined per category attribute set and is enforced at submission.
rules.notes: The Vendor API endpoint GET /catalog/attribute-sets/{id} returns minLength/maxLength per attribute, so the limits can be read programmatically by an authorised seller.

rules.requirement: Names and brands of other platforms may not be used in product names, descriptions or details.
rules.source_title: Product Listing Guideline - Jumia Global VendorHub
rules.notes: Stated as a platform rule for Jumia Global (cross-border) sellers; recorded as recommended because the local NG/KE VendorHub pages do not repeat it. Published on the Jumia Global VendorHub for cross-border (international) sellers; the local NG/KE VendorHub pages do not repeat it.

rules.requirement: All product images must match the product's title.
Provide a clear and detailed description of the product; the description should give the customer useful information to support a purchase.
rules.source_title: Product creation/update status - Jumia VendorHub NG
rules.notes: No description length limit or formatting rule is published on VendorHub NG/KE.

rules.requirement: Product descriptions must not use Chinese; images must not contain Chinese characters or watermarks.
rules.source_title: Product Listing Guideline - Jumia Global VendorHub
rules.notes: Stated as a platform rule for Jumia Global (cross-border) sellers; recorded as recommended because the local NG/KE VendorHub pages do not repeat it. Published on the Jumia Global VendorHub for cross-border (international) sellers; the local NG/KE VendorHub pages do not repeat it.

rules.requirement: Beauty products: give the ingredient list in the description, with all ingredients in descending order of concentration using INCI names, plus usage instructions and other relevant information (template also shows a "Free From" list).
rules.source_title: 2026 JG FBJ Beauty Product Guidelines - Jumia Global VendorHub
rules.notes: Stated as a requirement for Jumia Global FBJ cross-border sellers of beauty products (skin care, hair care, oral care, make-up, fragrance). Not published for local NG/KE sellers, so recorded here as recommended.

rules.requirement: Beauty products: write Product Highlights as USP 1, USP 2, USP 3, then Variant, Volume/Size, Age of Use, Choking Hazard (if applicable) and Allergens.
rules.source_title: 2026 JG FBJ Beauty Product Guidelines - Jumia Global VendorHub
rules.notes: Template for Jumia Global FBJ cross-border beauty sellers. No highlight count or length limit is published.

rules.requirement: All mandatory attribute fields of the category must be filled with valid data (data type, list values, length); otherwise the creation/update request is blocked with an error (form), an error report (file import) or an error message (API).
rules.source_title: Product creation/update status - Jumia VendorHub NG

rules.requirement: Attribute fields depend on the product category; some are common (colour, dimensions) and others category-specific. Use metric units (cm, m, L, kg).
Select the most precise (lowest-level) category; choosing a higher-level category is likely to be judged an incorrect category and fail content QC.
rules.source_title: Product Audit Timeliness/Results View - Jumia Global VendorHub
rules.notes: Stated as a platform rule for Jumia Global (cross-border) sellers; recorded as recommended because the local NG/KE VendorHub pages do not repeat it. Published on the Jumia Global VendorHub for cross-border (international) sellers; the local NG/KE VendorHub pages do not repeat it. The Jumia Global beauty guideline says to select the complete subcategory under Health & Beauty.

rules.requirement: Nigeria: edible, pharmaceutical and beauty products (including but not limited to lotions, lipsticks, powders, deodorants, nail polish and aerosol cans) all require NAFDAC Registration Numbers.
rules.notes: Quoted: "if you can ingest it, spray it, or apply it, it should be registered with NAFDAC." The product-creation page lists "NAFDAC Number, License, etc." among supporting documents for health or food items.

rules.requirement: Products in food-and-drug-agency regulated categories (e.g. foods, alcohol, cosmetics, tobacco) must have valid local registrations; the listing includes a mandatory field for the registration number.
rules.source_title: Prohibited and Restricted products - Jumia VendorHub KE
rules.notes: Same wording on the NG and KE policy pages (the KE page still refers to Nigeria and does not name the Kenyan regulator or a number format). No KEBS or Pharmacy and Poisons Board field is named on the Kenya VendorHub pages retrieved.

rules.requirement: All listings in food-and-drug-agency regulated product categories are limited to local sellers and Jumia-managed accounts only.
rules.source_title: Prohibited and Restricted Products Policy - Jumia VendorHub NG
rules.notes: The Jumia Global 2026 beauty guideline nevertheless describes a certified route for FBJ cross-border beauty sellers - the two pages are not reconciled publicly.

rules.requirement: Kenya (cross-border FBJ beauty sellers): certification requirement is the KEBS PVOC Certificate of Conformity (CoC); Nigeria: NAFDAC certification. Jumia does not provide certification services.
rules.source_title: 2026 JG FBJ Beauty Product Guidelines - Jumia Global VendorHub
rules.notes: Published on the Jumia Global VendorHub for cross-border (international) sellers; the local NG/KE VendorHub pages do not repeat it.

rules.requirement: Beauty stock sent to Jumia warehouses (FBJ) must have remaining shelf life of more than half its total shelf life and not less than 6 months.
rules.source_title: 2026 JG FBJ Beauty Product Guidelines - Jumia Global VendorHub
rules.notes: Published on the Jumia Global VendorHub for cross-border (international) sellers; the local NG/KE VendorHub pages do not repeat it.

rules.requirement: Select the correct brand from the platform database (create the brand first if missing); using a restricted "Generic" brand may need approval, and an authorisation letter may be required for branded products.
rules.source_title: Product creation/update status - Jumia VendorHub NG
rules.notes: Jumia Global adds that the Brand, Colour and Model fields are locked after the product is created/first passes QC.

rules.requirement: gtin_barcode is a mandatory field at product creation for all products that have a barcode printed on their packaging; Jumia maintains a list of brands and categories for which it is mandatory.
rules.notes: Identical on the Kenya page. Accepted types: GTIN-8, GTIN-12 (UPC-A), GTIN-13 (EAN), GTIN-14.

rules.requirement: Each GTIN is unique to a product: a seller cannot create more than one product with the same gtin_barcode in the same Jumia account.
A GTIN exemption can be requested only for brands where Jumia requires barcodes but the items carry no manufacturer barcode; photos of all sides of the product are needed.
Minimum image resolution is 500 x 500 px.
rules.notes: Scope: all images (main and secondary).

rules.requirement: Maximum image resolution is 3,000 x 3,000 px.
rules.notes: Scope: all images (main and secondary). Jumia Global (cross-border sellers) states 500x500 to 2000x2000 px and a 2 MB file limit instead.

rules.requirement: Images larger than 1,000 px on each side are recommended.
rules.notes: Scope: all images (main and secondary).

rules.requirement: At least 1 image is required.
6 images and a YouTube video id are recommended.
rules.notes: Jumia Global states a maximum of 8 images (1 main + 7 secondary).

rules.requirement: Accepted file formats: JPEG (.jpg/.jpeg), TIFF (.tif) or PNG (.png); JPEG is recommended.
rules.notes: Scope: all images (main and secondary).

rules.requirement: Images must be clear and unpixellated with no stretched or squashed edges; no watermark is recommended on any image.
rules.notes: Scope: all images (main and secondary).

rules.requirement: Image file name is composed of the product identifier, the variant code and the file extension (e.g. sellersku124.main.jpg for the main image).
rules.notes: Scope: all images (main and secondary).

rules.requirement: Main image must have a pure-white background (RGB 255, 255, 255).
Main image must show the product as more than 80% of the image, with the entire product inside the frame.
Main image must not have text, logos, borders, colour blocks, watermarks or other graphics covering the product or in the background.
Main image must not show accessories that are not included, must not include multiple product views in a single image, and must be a realistic professional image (not a placeholder).
No image may include customer reviews, five-star imagery, claims (e.g. free shipping), seller-specific information, pricing details, or Jumia badges (or anything confusingly similar).
rules.notes: Scope: all images (main and secondary).

rules.requirement: No image may contain nudity or sexually suggestive content, visible mannequins, or products that look second-hand or used.
rules.notes: Scope: all images (main and secondary).

rules.requirement: Recommended views for consumables: front view (product and key size/pieces information), back view (manufacturer details / composition) and an out-of-packaging view; for other general merchandise: front, back, side, detail, functionality and styled shots.
rules.notes: No beauty-specific row exists in the image-content table.

rules.requirement: Video is supplied as a YouTube video id alongside the images (recommended, not required).
rules.notes: No length, format or size limits are published. Jumia Global says the YouTube video is included in the product description.

rules.requirement: Complete attributes so customers can find the product through Jumia search and filters; GTINs are said to improve grouping and search visibility.
rules.notes: Jumia publishes no keyword-field or keyword-density guidance on the pages retrieved.

rules.requirement: Use correctly spelled words; avoid incorrect or variant spellings.
rules.source_title: Product Restricted Keywords Rules - Jumia Global VendorHub
rules.notes: Published on the Jumia Global VendorHub for cross-border (international) sellers; the local NG/KE VendorHub pages do not repeat it.

rules.requirement: Jumia supports a single variation only: a product may vary by one criterion (e.g. size) and not by two (e.g. size and colour).
Variations share one common image set, so only attributes that do not change the product's appearance (size, power, capacity) can be variations; colour and shape cannot.
rules.notes: Jumia Global beauty guideline: "Capacity can be used as a variant, while color should not be used as a variant." Different shades therefore need separate products.

rules.requirement: Variations must be fundamentally the same product, under the same brand, able to share a single title; do not group different products on one page.

Every product creation or update request passes a content quality check before it is published; statuses are "pending QC", "approved" and "rejected", and rejection reasons are shown per product and can be exported to Excel/CSV.
rules.source_title: Product creation/update status - Jumia VendorHub NG

rules.requirement: Changes may take up to several days to reflect on the app and website because of the quality check.
rules.source_title: Product creation/update status - Jumia VendorHub NG

rules.requirement: Product review is either automatic (results within a short time) or manual, which requires 1-2 business days.
rules.source_title: Product Audit Timeliness/Results View - Jumia Global VendorHub
rules.notes: Published on the Jumia Global VendorHub for cross-border (international) sellers; the local NG/KE VendorHub pages do not repeat it.

rules.requirement: Restriction rules (e.g. blacklisted keywords, categories or brands prohibited in specific countries) must pass for a creation/update to succeed; review rules then set the product to auto-approved, auto-rejected or Pending QC (manual).
rules.source_title: Content Quality Control (Content QC) - Jumia Global VendorHub
rules.notes: Published on the Jumia Global VendorHub for cross-border (international) sellers; the local NG/KE VendorHub pages do not repeat it.

rules.requirement: A listing that is never approved and never active within 90 days of creation is removed; it is flagged "Pending Deletion" from day 60.
rules.source_title: Keeping Your Catalog Healthy: 90-Day Cleanup for Unapproved Listings - Jumia VendorHub KE
rules.notes: Published on the Kenya VendorHub; described as a regular Jumia-wide clean-up.

rules.requirement: Official Store status is open only to the brand owner or an officially authorised distributor/reseller with a Letter of Authorization or trademark proof; only approved SKUs are eligible and the store must keep a vendor score and customer rating of at least 4.0.
rules.source_title: Official Store Standards Framework: Eligibility, Performance & Compliance Requirements - Jumia VendorHub KE
rules.notes: A seller-status programme, not a content format; described as applying across Jumia markets.

rules.requirement: At drop-off Jumia checks that the physical product matches the product page (brand, colour, size, model, other specifications); mismatches fail the quality check.

Product content may not use marketing-status words such as "promotion" or "best-selling", unsubstantiated statements such as "free shipping" or "100% original", or misleading phrases such as "colors are random", "as shown in the picture" or "contact us".
rules.source_title: Product Restricted Keywords Rules - Jumia Global VendorHub
rules.notes: Stated as a platform rule for Jumia Global (cross-border) sellers; recorded as recommended because the local NG/KE VendorHub pages do not repeat it. Published on the Jumia Global VendorHub for cross-border (international) sellers; the local NG/KE VendorHub pages do not repeat it. The full restricted-word list is not public.

rules.requirement: Keywords relating to sensitive country/religion/belief topics, indecent or vulgar language, counterfeit brand spellings, dangerous or prohibited goods, and content that misleads consumers can cause QC failure.
rules.source_title: Product Audit Timeliness/Results View - Jumia Global VendorHub
rules.notes: Stated as a platform rule for Jumia Global (cross-border) sellers; recorded as recommended because the local NG/KE VendorHub pages do not repeat it. Published on the Jumia Global VendorHub for cross-border (international) sellers; the local NG/KE VendorHub pages do not repeat it.

rules.requirement: Commonly prohibited cosmetic contents (reference list): whitening products containing hydroquinone, products containing corticosteroids, heavy metals (lead, mercury, arsenic, cadmium), hydrogen peroxide whitening products, and additives such as formaldehyde, benzene, phthalates and high-dose PPD.
rules.source_title: 2026 JG FBJ Beauty Product Guidelines - Jumia Global VendorHub
rules.notes: Published on the Jumia Global VendorHub for cross-border (international) sellers; the local NG/KE VendorHub pages do not repeat it. Marked "for reference only" and non-exhaustive; these are product-composition bans rather than wording rules.

rules.requirement: Prescription medicines and medical devices are always prohibited from sale on Jumia; counterfeit and used products are prohibited.
rules.source_title: Prohibited and Restricted Products Policy - Jumia VendorHub NG

enhanced_content.eligibility: Not publicly documented. No A+/enhanced-content programme, module list or eligibility rule appears on VendorHub NG/KE, Jumia Global VendorHub or in the Vendor API.
enhanced_content.modules_note: Product content is name, description, highlights, attributes, up to 8 images and an optional YouTube video. The Official Store programme (brand owner or authorised distributor) is a seller badge with performance standards, not a content format.

official_quality_signals.what_it_measures: Jumia Global describes it as product content parameters "such as images, descriptions, and product names" meeting the platform's requirements; a good Content Score is listed as a way to improve the QC approval rate.
official_quality_signals.notes: The Jumia Global FAQ (2026-05-08) answers "Where can I check the Content Score product score?" with "This function is under development." The older Seller Center exposed a Content Score per product, but its documentation pages were unreachable or returned 404 on 2026-11-26, so their thresholds are not recorded.

official_quality_signals.official_name: QC status (content Quality Check status and rejection reasons)
official_quality_signals.what_it_measures: Whether a product creation/update passed Jumia content QC, and why it was rejected.
official_quality_signals.components: Status values NOT_READY_TO_QC, PENDING, APPROVED, REJECTED; rejectionReason and rejectionComment (up to 5 rejection reasons shown in the portal).
official_quality_signals.who_can_access: Sellers in Vendor Center (Manage Products > QC status; export of rejected products to Excel/CSV) and authorised Vendor API applications (GET /catalog/products with the qcStatus filter).
official_quality_signals.notes: A pass/fail diagnostic, not a graded score. Also available as a downloadable report (Import/Export > Export products, filter "Rejected"; reasons are in the last columns).

limitations: Public VendorHub pages for Nigeria and Kenya cover images, attributes, GTINs, variations, QC and policy, but they publish no character limits for product name, description or highlights - those are set per category in Vendor Center templates and the attribute-set API, which need a seller login. Several rules come from the Jumia Global VendorHub (cross-border sellers) and are flagged as such; they may not be enforced identically for local sellers. Kenya-specific regulatory fields (KEBS, Pharmacy and Poisons Board) are not named on Jumia Kenya pages - only the generic "mandatory field for the FDA registration number". The legacy Content Score pages (guide.sellercenter.jumia.com, contentguidelines.jumia.com.ng / .co.ke, a vendorhub.jumia.ug course) were unreachable or 404, and current documentation says the Content Score view is under development. The Seller Score (shipping speed, average product rating, quality return rate, cancellation rate) is a seller-level performance score, not a content score. No enhanced-content programme and no video specification were found.
